rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an insightful person, comment, or idea.

example.english: Her analysis of the issue is very insightful.
example.traditional: 佢對件事嘅分析好有見地。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 gin6 si6 ge3 fan1 sik1 hou2 jau5 gin3 dei6

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing the ability to perceive underlying truths or relationships.

example.english: They are very insightful and can spot the root of the problem at a glance.
example.traditional: 佢好有洞察力，一眼就睇到問題嘅根源。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 jau5 dung6 caat3 lik6 jat1 ngaan5 zau6 tai2 dou2 man6 tai4 ge3 gan1 jyun4

rows.note: Use this colloquial expression when someone sees through a situation or understands its underlying reality.

example.english: You’re really insightful; you saw through why he did that straight away.
example.traditional: 你真係睇得透，一早就知道佢點解咁做。
example.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 tai2 dak1 tau3 jat1 zou2 zau6 zi1 dou6 keoi5 dim2 gaai2 gam3 zou6
